title: The elicited checklist-anchor mounts the checklist at the resolved slot or a defined fallback
asA: operator applying application-onboarding-tour with a chosen checklist-anchor
iWant: the checklist to appear in the anchored slot with a defined open state and a defined fallback
soThat: the checklist never lands silently in the wrong place or disappears without a reason I can trace

acceptanceCriteria.description: When checklist-anchor is `dashboard-top` and application-dashboard is applied, the checklist mounts at the top of the dashboard route as a <details data-role="onboarding-tour-checklist"> element with open=false by default.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the DOM carries a <details data-role="onboarding-tour-checklist" open=false> element as the first child of the dashboard content region

acceptanceCriteria.description: When checklist-anchor is `settings-page` and application-account-settings is applied, the checklist mounts on the settings route with the same shape and default open=false.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the DOM carries a <details data-role="onboarding-tour-checklist" open=false> element inside the settings content region

acceptanceCriteria.description: When checklist-anchor is `custom-anchor` and the elicited CSS selector resolves to a visible, unclipped element on load, the checklist mounts inside that element with open=false and data-role=onboarding-tour-checklist. Template values the applying agent sets: the anchor-selectors elicit's selector string.
acceptanceCriteria.given: checklist-anchor=custom-anchor with a resolvable, visible selector
acceptanceCriteria.when: the route with that selector renders
acceptanceCriteria.then: the DOM carries the <details data-role="onboarding-tour-checklist"> inside the resolved element

acceptanceCriteria.description: When checklist-anchor is `custom-anchor` and the selector resolves to nothing, to an invisible element or to a clipped element that cannot fit the checklist, the checklist mounts on the settings route as a fallback and the console log carries data-error=CHECKLIST_ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED naming the selector string. No dialog floats loose over the underlying surface.
acceptanceCriteria.given: checklist-anchor=custom-anchor with an unresolvable, invisible or clipped selector
acceptanceCriteria.then: the checklist mounts on the settings route and data-error=CHECKLIST_ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED is logged with the selector; no floating dialog surfaces

acceptanceCriteria.description: When no dashboard surface, no settings surface and no usable custom anchor are available, the checklist suppresses entirely (no element is written to the DOM) and the sidecar records checklistSuppressed:true with the reason.
acceptanceCriteria.given: no dashboard, no settings and no usable custom anchor applied
acceptanceCriteria.then: no <details data-role="onboarding-tour-checklist"> is present and the sidecar records checklistSuppressed:true
